mapper.select: SELECT opr_hstry_sn , opr_ymd , CASE DAYOFWEEK(opr_ymd) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END AS day , ownr_nm , oprtr_id , CAST(AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(oprtr_nm), 'theimc') AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET UTF8MB4) AS oprtr_nm , rfid_no , rq_bk_tm , actl_bk_tm , frst_tm , last_tm , IFNULL(opr_schdl, '[]') AS opr_schdl , tdrvg_dstnc , reg_dt , mdfcn_dt FROM anls_opr_hstry WHERE 1 = 1 AND opr_hstry_sn = #{oprHstrySn}
